title: Incident: Amplify rebuild stuck on submodule fetch
author: Greg
summary: Amplify build held 18 minutes waiting on a stale submodule pointer. Resolved by manual PAT rotation. Postmortem inside.

sections.heading: Impact
bullets: One Amplify rebuild for the parent site blocked for 18 minutes.
No client surfaces were degraded. The previous deploy continued to serve.

sections.heading: Root cause
bullets: Fine-grained parent PAT expired two days earlier than calendar tracked.
Submodule fetch fell back to HTTPS and stalled on auth prompt.

sections.heading: Fix
bullets: Rotated the parent PAT. Restarted the Amplify build.
Added a calendar reminder 7 days ahead of the next PAT expiry.

sections.heading: Follow-ups
bullets: Add an actions-level smoke event that exercises dispatch weekly.
Move PAT expiry tracking from calendar to the ops dashboard.
